Where each license text in this folder came from, unchanged.

  https://github.com/KDE/oxygen-sounds at commit
  114e2b856deebc2153444d5707c0ed17001b252c, fetched on 2026-11-09.

  https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode.txt
  fetched on 2026-11-10.

GPL-3.0.txt
  https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.txt
  fetched on 2026-11-10. The LGPL 3.0 is written as additions to it.
